name: RAC-Board
author: Mateusz Kłysz
description: Jak II's JET-Board for Ratchet. Summon the board and ride it with Jak II's own physics and states: ollies, duck jumps, spins, flips, grabs, grinds, wall kicks, and their quirks. Ratchet keeps Clank on his back. Our own board model and sounds, nothing from either game's disc.

settings.name: Board on and off
settings.description: The pad button that gets on the board and off it. R2 also strafes with the lock-strafe and keyboard-mouse mods.

settings.name: Board on and off (keyboard)
settings.description: The key that gets on the board and off it.

settings.name: Crouch on R1
settings.description: On: duck and grabs on R1, spins and flips on L1, as Ratchet crouches on R1. Off: Jak II's buttons, duck and grabs on L1, spins and flips on R1.

settings.name: Trick names and points
settings.description: Shows each combo's tricks and points at the top of the picture, as OpenGOAL's Jak II does.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for each board state change.
